name: Korean peninsula
summary: North Korea tested a cluster-warhead missile on 31 Oct; on 3 Nov it denied the Binance theft
state: North Korea fired a tactical ballistic missile towards the Yellow Sea on 31 Oct, testing a cluster warhead, two days after a salvo of about ten short-range missiles. On 3 Nov Kim Yo Jong called the FBI's finding that North Korea stole $6.3bn from Binance 'absurd rhetoric' (ABC News). No further launch had been reported as of 3 Nov.
for_you: No direct risk to the UK. Travellers to South Korea can follow FCDO travel advice.

sources.title: ANI — North Korea tests cluster warhead for tactical ballistic missiles

why: North Korea is a nuclear state with ICBMs; tension here involves the US, China, Japan and Russia simultaneously.
